panels.title: 冷开场：桌面上的一颗芯片
lines: 阿凯：就这么指甲盖大一片，里面真有上百亿个开关？（手机芯片约两百亿量级，核查 r1）
林工：说不清的话，进去看看。
panels.prompt: A sunlit wooden desk in a cozy study. Kai sits leaning in, holding a small flat square black chip package with smooth edges and NO pins or leads on its sides (a ball-grid-array package, its solder balls hidden underneath) about one centimeter square, no markings, no logo in fine tweezers close to his eye, squinting at it. An opened generic smartphone circuit board (no brand) lies on the desk. Lin stands beside him with a slight knowing smile, glancing at the round dial of her wrist watch. Medium close shot, the chip in sharp focus in the foreground, warm afternoon light.

panels.title: 转场：缩小
lines: （转场笑点）阿凯：等一下，我还没准备——
panels.prompt: The two characters standing on the desk surface right next to the flat square black chip package with smooth edges and NO pins or leads on its sides (a ball-grid-array package, its solder balls hidden underneath), already shrunk to the height of a grain of rice: the package towers beside them like a low flat black building with clean smooth sides, the desk's wood grain spreads like a vast rippled field, a pencil in the background lies like a giant fallen log. Lin calmly turns the dial on her wrist watch; Kai flails slightly, startled, hair lifted, a subtle motion blur suggesting rapid shrinking. Low wide-angle shot, playful mood.

panels.source: Blender 结构 + Seedance 人物
panels.title: 黑壳不是芯片
lines: 阿凯：这块黑的就是芯片吧？
林工：这只是外壳。真正的芯片藏在里面，是一片很薄的硅。
panels.prompt: The two characters stand on a green circuit board beneath the edge of a chip package, at a scale where the package's solder balls are taller than them: a neat grid of giant shiny silvery solder spheres holds up the flat dark package above like columns of a covered walkway. Kai points up at the dark package overhead with a questioning look; Lin shakes her head with a smile and gestures inward. Low angle, soft light filtering in from the open side.

panels.title: 剖开外壳：里面那片硅
lines: 林工：它是倒扣着的，正面朝下，靠底下这一排小凸点和外面连起来。（倒扣朝向待核）
panels.prompt: Clean architectural cross-section diagram of a chip package, cut straight through and seen from the side, layers stacked from bottom to top: a green circuit board; a row of large silvery solder balls; a layered package substrate with thin copper traces; a dense row of small copper bumps; a thin flat slab of grey silicon resting face-down on those bumps; a dark protective mold cap on top. The two characters stand on the package substrate in the narrow gap between substrate and silicon, the small copper bumps around them reaching their waist to shoulder height, the thin silicon slab forming a low flat ceiling just above their heads. Kai looks up at the silicon ceiling, Lin points at it. Cut faces slightly lighter, each layer clearly separated and readable.

panels.source: Blender + 网页叠加示意色块
panels.title: 硅片表面：哪块是 CPU？
lines: 阿凯：哪块是 CPU？
林工：从上面其实看不出来。给它涂个色，你就明白了。（叠加示意色块：CPU、GPU、缓存）
panels.prompt: The protective package has been lifted away like a cutaway, and the two characters stand on a vast flat silicon chip surface stretching to the horizon, smooth metallic grey, lit by soft even studio-like light from above; no sky, no clouds, the distance fades into soft pale haze. Very subtle large rectangular regions differ slightly in texture: one region a fine regular tiled grid pattern, another a fine irregular texture; broad parallel metal power stripes cross the surface like low wide roads. Kai shades his eyes looking far across; Lin gestures across the landscape. No bright colors on the surface, everything understated. Wide high-angle shot.

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 比例准确）
panels.title: 坐电梯往下：越往下越细
lines: 林工：往下走。越往下，线越细、越密。
panels.prompt: The two characters ride downward standing on a small square copper plate sinking through the top layers of a microchip's wiring: huge thick copper beams with rectangular cross-sections, wide and far apart, pass beside and above them like massive bridge girders, embedded in pale translucent glassy material. Below them, layers of progressively thinner and denser copper lines are visible, each layer's lines running perpendicular to the layer above it. Looking-down perspective, sense of descending.

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 比例准确）
panels.title: 导线城市：这些不是晶体管
lines: 阿凯：这些就是晶体管？
林工：不是，这些是导线，大多是铜，十几层，把底下的开关连起来。
panels.prompt: Middle wiring layers of a microchip: dense parallel copper wires with rectangular cross-sections, slightly taller than wide, evenly spaced; alternate layers run in perpendicular directions; short square copper vias connect the layers; pale translucent glassy material fills the gaps. Kai stands on a wire looking around in awe and pointing at the wires with a question; Lin stands calmly beside him, shaking her head gently. Characters small in frame, sense of a vast orderly city of wires.

panels.source: Blender + 网页叠加；另插真实 TEM 灰度图（待授权）
panels.title: 为什么拍不到
lines: 阿凯：我拍一张——咦，怎么是糊的？
林工：光的波长比这些导线还宽，这里本来就「看」不见。你看到的颜色，是我们为了分清材料涂上的。
panels.prompt: Among dense copper wires inside a microchip, Kai holds up his smartphone to photograph them, but the phone screen shows only a soft featureless blur; he frowns at it, puzzled. A single giant translucent rippling wave of light, a smooth undulating band with a faint soft rainbow tint, sweeps through the scene; its wavelength is visibly wider than several copper wires together, washing over them without resolving any detail. Lin explains with an open palm. Gentle humor.

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 比例准确）
panels.title: 到底了：一排排栅极
lines: 林工：到底了。这一根根竖着的叫栅极，间距大约 50 纳米。
panels.prompt: The bottom level of a microchip: rows of identical equal-height cells separated by flat metal rails; thin vertical gate lines stand in a perfectly regular fence-like array with equal spacing, each gate line about as tall as the characters; tiny vertical contacts rise from them to thin copper lines just overhead; the base below is cool blue-grey silicon. Lin walks between two gate rows explaining; Kai trails behind, touching a gate line with curiosity. Strong regular rhythm and perspective lines.

panels.title: 一个晶体管：没有会动的零件
lines: 阿凯：开关在哪？一个会动的零件都没有啊。
林工：就是它。它不靠动来开关——怎么做到的，下一期讲。
panels.prompt: Close view of a single gate-all-around transistor: three to four thin flat horizontal sheets of cool blue-grey silicon stacked with even gaps, passing straight through a block of dark steel-grey gate metal that wraps completely around each sheet, with a very thin pale insulating layer in between; source and drain blocks at either end. The two characters stand beside it, each about as tall as the stack; Kai peers into the gap between sheets, puzzled; Lin points at the wrapping gate. Clean, readable, calm.

panels.source: Blender（晶格真实 · 原子小球示意）
panels.title: 原子：四十几层厚
lines: 林工：这一片硅，只有四十几层原子厚。
panels.prompt: Atomic scale: the cut edge of one thin silicon sheet seen as a crystal lattice of evenly spaced matte blue-grey spheres in a diamond-cubic arrangement, atomic layers clearly countable from top to bottom, extending into the distance. Kai kneels and counts the layers with one finger, astonished; Lin crouches beside him, smiling. Soft light, spheres rendered like smooth matte clay.

panels.source: Seedance（AI 画面 · 非结构）+ 网页数字揭晓
panels.title: 猜一猜缩小了多少倍
lines: 林工：猜猜，我们缩小了多少倍？
阿凯：一千倍？
林工：三千多万倍——一米七的人，缩到五十纳米高。（按人物与纳米片堆同高自算，讲稿时复核）
panels.prompt: Kai and Lin sit side by side on the edge of a stack of thin blue-grey silicon sheets, legs dangling. Kai holds up one hand with fingers spread, guessing a number with a playful confident grin; Lin raises an eyebrow, amused, about to reveal the answer. Soft-focus regular rows of transistor structures in the background. Warm, light-hearted mood, medium shot.

panels.title: 回程：一路倒放
lines: （转场笑点，无对白或阿凯一声欢呼）
panels.prompt: Fast zoom-out: the two characters shoot rapidly upward with motion streaks, layers of copper wires flashing past and dropping away below them, bright light opening up above, a strong sense of speed. Kai whoops with arms out and his hood flapping; Lin holds her glasses in place, laughing. Dynamic vertical composition.

panels.source: Seedance（AI 画面 · 非结构）+ 片尾卡
panels.title: 回到桌面：一句话记住
lines: 阿凯：所以芯片就是——最底下上百亿个开关，上面十几层导线。
林工：对。可它们一个零件都不会动，凭什么能开能关？下期见。
panels.prompt: Back at the sunlit wooden desk at normal size: Kai holds his smartphone and looks at it with new eyes, a thoughtful smile; Lin leans on the edge of the desk, satisfied, arms folded. The small flat square black chip package with smooth edges and NO pins or leads on its sides (a ball-grid-array package, its solder balls hidden underneath) rests on the desk in the foreground. Warm afternoon light, calm ending, medium shot.
